evals.prompt: Extract a blueprint from this React Native Expo app
evals.expected_output: Produces features.md, features.json, and design-system.md from source code analysis
assertions: runs deterministic detection first, then LLM-enriched analysis
generates features.json with structured API contracts
generates design-system.md with component and style documentation

evals.prompt: I want to re-implement this mobile app, help me understand its structure
evals.expected_output: Activates blueprint extraction for re-implementation planning
assertions: extracts features, API contracts, and design system
output is useful for rebuilding the app

evals.prompt: Build a new React Native app with authentication and a dashboard
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT activate (building new app, not extracting blueprint)
assertions: skill does not trigger for greenfield development
